Emre Yalcin  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6543 | emre.yalcin@email.com | linkedin.com/in/emreyalcin | github.com/emreyalcin  

Professional Experience  
As a frontend engineer at NexaCorp, I’ve spearheaded the development of scalable, user-centric interfaces for enterprise SaaS platforms. During my internship in 2021, I optimized the company’s internal dashboard UI, reducing load time by 30% through Next.js-based static generation and browser devtools-driven performance audits. This work supported 10k+ daily users, and I later expanded my role as a junior engineer in 2022, leading the redesign of the company’s public-facing portal. By integrating TypeScript and Redux, I improved state management efficiency, cutting bug resolution time by 40% across the team. In 2023, I transitioned to a full frontend engineer role, where I architected a modular component library used across 80% of the product suite, streamlining cross-team collaboration. My work on REST API integrations for the customer analytics module reduced endpoint latency by 25%, directly contributing to a 15% increase in user engagement metrics.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering, Istanbul Technical University (2021). Graduated with honors, specializing in distributed systems and real-time web applications. My thesis focused on optimizing client-server communication patterns for high-concurrency environments, a skillset I’ve applied to NexaCorp’s global user base.  

Technical Skills  
My frontend expertise is rooted in building performant, accessible interfaces for enterprise-scale applications. At NexaCorp, I leveraged React and Next.js to create a dynamic dashboard that handles 10k+ concurrent users, utilizing browser devtools for real-time performance monitoring. I designed REST APIs for the customer analytics module, ensuring seamless integration with backend services while maintaining strict latency targets. My work on state management with Redux reduced redundant data fetching by 35%, improving overall application responsiveness. I’ve also championed responsive design principles, ensuring all components adapt to 100% of screen sizes, and I’ve implemented WCAG 2.1 compliance across all projects, with a focus on keyboard navigation and ARIA labels. TypeScript has been integral to my workflow, enabling early error detection and scalable code maintenance.  

Projects  
I developed a modular component library for NexaCorp’s SaaS platform, which is now used across 80% of the product suite. This library reduced duplication by 60% and accelerated feature rollout cycles. I also led the redesign of the company’s public portal, implementing a responsive design that improved mobile conversion rates by 22%. My work on the customer analytics module involved designing REST endpoints that processed 500k+ data points per second, ensuring sub-200ms response times. I’ve also contributed to internal tools, such as a code quality dashboard that tracks browser devtools metrics across 50+ environments.

Google Developers Certificate in Web Fundamentals (2022) | Udacity Frontend NanoDegree (2023)
